chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: '1966 round 50 cent lot' and '1966 round 50c x8' / 'x10' (bulk lots, last 90 days); '1966 round 50 cent uncirculated' singles; Noble Numismatics and Leski realised prices for '1966 round 50c' lots of 5 to 20 coins; Downies and Status International realised for same.
viewing_check: Check each of the 8 coins for wear on the high points (Queen's hair, kangaroo and emu) to separate true Unc from aUNC; look for the double bar variety (two bars on the 50 numeral in the reverse) which sells for more; confirm all eight are 1966 and none are cleaned, scratched or toned. Any 2x2 holders or original packaging help.
rate_note: All prices AUD, rate 1.0. About 85 g fine silver in the lot; no melt price was taken from the databases, so check spot silver in Chrome.
